statement: The Saptavimshamsa (D27, also called Nakshatramsa or Bhamsa) is read for inherent strengths and weaknesses of character — the chart's own account of what a person is fundamentally built of.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
